identity.name: Running

balance.stacking_limits: Does not stack with another movement bonus of the same kind. The best one counts.

using.effect: Movement and a boost: adds the skill's rank step to checks built on Speed, such as chases, races, and fleeing. It does not raise Speed itself. Flying, swimming, and climbing are other entries.
